desc: Protect your gear and stay ready for the season with the Allen Company Daytona 46-Inch Soft Rifle Case-built for hunters, target shooters, and firearm enthusiasts who demand durability and function. Designed to fit rifles up to 46 inches long, this soft-sided case features dense foam padding and a tough Endura fabric shell to safeguard your firearm from scratches, impacts, and the elements during transport or storage.
